eyebrow: Telecommunications & network engineer · Tech builder · Freelancer
availability: Open to work, collaborations and freelance projects.
bio: I study telecommunications and network engineering at the University of Doha for Science and Technology, and I build products alongside it. It is one interest, not two: the firmware on a street-lighting rig and the retrieval layer behind a study companion are both systems where the interesting part is what happens between the components, and where being wrong is measurable. I have taken a product from a 48-hour hackathon build to first place at the UHUB x Scale AI Sprint, spoken at Web Summit Qatar, and spent two months on DMZ's Basecamp programme in Toronto.
currently: Finishing the degree at UDST, building Eshrahli, and open to freelance work.
